title: Temozolomide and olaparib for the treatment of an ARID1A-mutated uterine carcinosarcoma: A case report.
snippet: Pathogenicmutations are common in uterine carcinosarcoma (UCS) and may confer vulnerability to the combination of temozolomide (TMZ) and a poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitor (PARPi) through synthetic lethality. Clinical experience with this regimen in gynecologic cancers is limited and has not been reported in UCS. A 54-year-old woman with stage IIIB UC...
